_note: CTCAE grading catalog for the StewardMD onco-ctcae engine (Phase 8 P2). CTCAE is NCI public-domain, so REAL grade definitions are seeded here, but ACCURACY over coverage: only a curated set of the most common chemo/IO-relevant adverse events is included, each grade quoted verbatim from NCI CTCAE v5.0 and flagged requiresR1Verification. A grade that CTCAE does not define at that level is represented by null (rendered as an honest 'not defined at this grade'), NEVER by an invented cut-off. Any adverse event NOT listed here is an explicit gap: consult the full NCI CTCAE v5.0. The v4.03 edition is present in the version toggle but intentionally NOT seeded (a marked gap) because the v4.03 grade deltas are not reproduced here. Do not flip requiresR1Verification off, and do not add or edit a threshold, without R1 clinical sign-off against the licensed/official NCI CTCAE source.
gapMessage: Consult the full NCI CTCAE v5.0. This adverse event (or grade) is not seeded in StewardMD.
